        for i in range(n-1, 0, -1):
            if perm[i] < perm[i-1]:
                perm[i], perm[i-1] = perm[i-1], perm[i]
                break
    return perm

    remaining_swaps = k % (n - 1)
    
    # Perform full cycles
    for _ in range(full_cycles):
        for i in range(n - 1):
            perm[i], perm[i + 1] = perm[i + 1], perm[i]
    
    # Perform remaining swaps
    for i in range(remaining_swaps):
        if i == 0 and perm[0] > perm[1]:
            continue
        perm[i], perm[i + 1] = perm[i + 1], perm[i]
    
    return perm
